publication.citation: Horcas, S. G., et al. (2022), Vibrations of wind turbine blades in standstill: Mapping the influence of inflow angles, Physics of Fluids 34, 054105

digitization.method: Map the published P-I axes to the Figure 4(a) color field, then map the nearest colorbar value to peak-to-peak displacement.
digitization.conversion: For a near-harmonic response, the Fu peak amplitude sqrt(2)*RMS equals one half of the Horcas peak-to-peak displacement.

evidence_role.allowed: Training-only angular/configuration response at U=18 m/s.
evidence_role.prohibited: The four points are not independent validation and are not author-provided raw histories.
